articles.title: People Are Acting Weird As Hell During Fortnite’s Treasure Hunt
articles.dek: The search for the Pirate Shop token has dramatically changed the flow of a Fortnite match.
articles.excerpt: Fortnite's new Treasure Hunters season is such a massive success that the battle royale's player counts are five times higher than last week, because everybody and their mothers want in on the search for Tim Sweeney's golden ticket. It grants everything in the item shop for free, both for two weeks this year and two more weeks in 2027. articles.title: The Best Warzone Perks May Surprise You After The MW4 Overhaul
articles.dek: Warzone perks are changing with Modern Warfare 4's integration.
articles.excerpt: Modern Warfare 4 integrates with Warzone for Season 1, adding MW4's full weapon pool, attachments, and other new gear into battle royale. The big update also overhauls Warzone's perk system, including the introduction of the powerful new "Elite" perks.
